//dependencies: Anything needed to BUILD or RUN in production lives here, not in devDependencies. Managed Node hosts (Hostinger included) commonly set NODE_ENV=production before installing, which makes npm skip devDependencies entirely — so a build-time package parked in devDependencies fails the deploy with a missing-module error. sharp is here because Next uses it for runtime image optimisation; without it Next silently serves unoptimised originals with nothing in the logs.
//devDependencies: Local development and CI only. Nothing here is required by `next build`.
